depositFor(address,address,uint256).notice: Deposit `underlyingAmount` of `underlying` into the protocol on behalf of `maker`. Pulls the tokens from the maker wallet — maker must have approved this adapter for underlying spending.

exchangeRate(address).notice: Current exchange rate: how many underlying per 1 yield token (1e18 precision). Used by the SwapVM opcode for accurate quoting.

underlyingToYield(address,uint256).notice: Converts underlying amount to yield token amount at current rate (rounded up).

withdrawTo(address,address,uint256,addre.notice: Withdraw `underlyingAmount` of `underlying` from the protocol on behalf of `maker`, sending real tokens to `recipient`. Pulls the equivalent yield tokens from the maker wallet — maker must have approved this adapter for yield token spending.

yieldToUnderlying(address,uint256).notice: Converts yield token amount to underlying at current rate.

yieldToken(address).notice: Returns the yield-bearing token for a given underlying. e.g. underlying=WETH → yieldToken=aWETH
